description: Construction of a basement extension incorporating a lightwell to front and a glass rooflight to rear of the existing house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Flood risk assessment, Method Statement, arboricultural implication study & tree protection strategy, design & access statement, 250/001-P1, 250/002-P1 Received: 27/04/2021; 
250/010-P2 & Construction Logistics Plan Received: 28/05/2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The basement hereby permitted shall be built in line with flood management measures as shown in the submitted and hereby approved Flood Risk Assessment.

Condition : 6 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.
Condition : 7 - The development hereby permitted shall be built in line with the hereby approved Construction Management Plan and Construction Logistics Plan
Condition : 8 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
